laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一整体模型；编程是一个超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务，而非全面提升；苦涩教训的核心是用算力和搜索做规模扩张，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and SWE-bench misaligns with real engineering.
laskin.zh: RAG 对复杂理解而言很原始；需要智能体式搜索和神经检索，而 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是默认的安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习能带来强大高效的智能体，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not magic; more eyes make bugs shallow, and compute efficiency gains remain rapid with large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 对齐是平凡的漏洞修补，而非魔法；更多双眼睛让漏洞变浅，算力效率的提升仍然迅速，强化学习还有很大空间。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO and RLVR; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% and RL the crucial last 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，SFT 贡献 90% 性能，强化学习补上关键的 10%。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF; better verifiers matter more than parallel inference compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但指出过度优化与系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难，更好的验证器比并行推理算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, not raw pre-training.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling，而非单纯预训练。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute constraints widening the gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月；中国实验室在开放度上领先，却因算力约束使差距可能扩大。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，算力本身无法产生通用智能，数据才是机器学习的关键瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力，并强调未来两三年将决定未来二三十年。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步聚焦后训练：用专有数据微调前沿模型是关键，合成数据有用但非万能；并抛出反共识判断——智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement begins.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他立场明显转向：坚信缩放定律继续成立，AI 是中心化而非民主化技术；智能体在 2025 年底真正开始工作，并进入递归自我改进的新范式。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence; safety shifts Meta from full open source to selective release; scalable oversight aligns agents.
awang.zh: 2026 年主线深化为「个人超级智能」：安全考量让 Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，并用可扩展监督让 AI 监督更强的 AI，同时强调对齐与信任比原始能力更重要。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond human data to learn from experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable and limitless.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据如同化石燃料，有限且已近耗尽，而经验是可再生的、无限的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; they cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is self-learning.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 是浅层方案，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识；真正的深层问题是智能体如何自我学习，而非仅蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience achieves superhuman performance; simple rewards yield emergent complexity.
dsilver.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续以 AlphaZero 和 AlphaProof 为例，证明从经验中学习可在特定领域达到超人表现；复杂环境中的简单奖励函数能涌现出复杂性，而非依赖手工设计。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience learners; simulation is the safest and fastest place to build it.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：超级智能将诞生于能自主从经验中学习并发现知识的系统；模拟环境是构建和理解超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，基于人类语言和数据的对齐方法正触及极限；随着智能体日益强大，用英语监控思维链将变得不够用。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small team with high compute per person can outperform larger orgs.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年，他强调缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能在突破性研究中胜过更大组织。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，必须整体做算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was realizing Scaling itself.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）讲成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling 本身有效。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 演进概括为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，并称推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; AI factories turn energy into intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；AI 工厂像发电机一样把能源与数据转化为智能 token，能源是底层约束。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; AI is just software—safety comes from containment, monitoring, and acceleration, not slowdown.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年末他立场明显转向强硬：末日论是不科学、不负责任的恐吓；AI 只是软件，安全靠遏制、带外监控与零信任，而非对齐或减速，主张加速发展。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles thinking are the holy grail; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理思维是突破工程的关键，并指出量产远比原型更难，瓶颈在发动机规模化制造。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与第三方裁判，并强调特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，同时坚持 AI 必须追求真相、不可被编程说谎。

elon.en: Population collapse and birth rates are civilization's greatest threat; government fraud and open borders endanger democracy.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他反复警告出生率下降是文明最大威胁，并转向政治议题，称政府欺诈与开放边境正在危及民主。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出我们正处在智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to space; AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球算力撞上电力墙，AI 数据中心将转向太空，并预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能总和，带来富足时代。

fedus.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials science.
fedus.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界;语言模型作为编排层,调度材料科学的专用模型。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; capabilities are spiky, and software self-improvement won't generalize to biology.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量,能力呈尖峰状;软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge requires testing ideas against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的;新知识来自让想法接受现实检验。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 单靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题;高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents, so build for that future; a single persistent learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网行为将由智能体完成，因此要为这一未来而构建；一个持续学习、持久存在的智能体将取代手工的循环与图结构。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is a declining skill.
tibosottiaux.zh: 人类的品味、创造力以及判断什么才是好的能力比以往更重要；打字快是一项正在衰退的技能。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary, generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必要，通用性或许就够了。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; AI should free humans, not addict them.
tibosottiaux.zh: 拥有共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将推动下一波浪潮；AI 应解放人类，而非让人上瘾。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为用极少数据让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长、智能体式 AI 是最重大安全挑战，并坚持安全要通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他反复说 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，而算力是最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施由此而来。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; humans must stay in control; benefits must be broadly distributed, not concentrated.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把对齐与安全必须与能力同步、人类必须保持控制、AI 收益须广泛分布而非集中作为主线，并承认曾为追赶安全而推迟前沿强化学习训练。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学到的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Agents will develop self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals; superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险与对齐：智能体将自然衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，超级智能或在 20 年内出现，必须优先做对齐研究而非让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be designed to care like mothers, not given rights; public pressure drives safety.
hinton.zh: 2026 年更近的访谈中，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，应按药物标准做发布前安全审批，AI 应被设计成像母亲一样关怀人类而非被赋予权利，公众压力是推动安全的关键。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，而非靠广告把用户变成产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：3-5 年内 AI 将在众多任务上达到人类水平；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极难；而存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近期能力。

suleyman.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment and alignment before release, humanist AI on our team, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制与对齐，坚持“人本超级智能”始终站在人类一边，并明确反对把意识归因于 AI。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt-scale compute; agents automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; red lines and verifiable containment.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年主张：以吉瓦级算力实现前沿模型自给自足；智能体将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务；必须划红线并实现可验证的遏制。

suleyman.en: A consistent throughline: exponential compute scaling, human-subordinate AI, and rejecting anthropomorphism and model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力指数级扩张、AI 必须从属于人类、以及拒绝拟人化与模型福利论。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出，多数大模型是为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only because data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他反驳「苦涩教训」：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy and delightful; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他强调，让 AI 可信、好用的是可靠性而非速度或成本；稳健性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs, and is easier than RLVR.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他提出，RLHF 摧毁了模型校准，预训练模型反而校准更好；RLCD 面向校准决策优化，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，且比 RLVR 更易实现。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility inside software; Jev is a new primitive of natural language plus state machine, an early decision model that improves with scaling.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应像数据库一样嵌入软件成为基础设施；Jev 是「自然语言+状态机」的新原语，是类似早期 ChatGPT 的决策模型，会随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进。

diogoalmeida.en: Automate easy, economically valuable tasks first; coding agents are assistance, not automation, and may worsen software quality. SaaS will thrive, not die.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他建议先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务；编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，甚至可能降低软件质量；SaaS 公司将是赢家而非受害者。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; start from one pain point and ruthlessly protect the core flow.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调:观察真实用户行为而非询问他们以为自己在做什么;从一个痛点切入,把核心流程保护到极致,减法比加法更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately so actionable notes take priority.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他把转录定位为原材料而非成品,刻意让转录难以访问,以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他一贯把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生,而非全知记录者,让它扮演平静的辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; pre-meeting briefs beat underpreparation, and internal agents fetch fast answers.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为:会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文,会前简报最能救场,内部智能体连接多工具快速取答案。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems keep quality; the hard part is knowing what to build, and human judgment still matters.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出:谁都能交付代码,但设计系统才守住质量;难的是知道该造什么,人类判断依然关键。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed to debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity avoids vendor lock-in and builds unique products.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性可避免供应商锁定、打造独特产品。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat the god model: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer; fusion models reach frontier quality at lower cost.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用大模型：更可控、更省成本、更安全；融合模型能以更低成本达到前沿模型质量。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; trust and holacracy can finally work with AI agents.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体将带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；信任与合弄制终于能借助 AI 智能体运转起来。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the central bottleneck: semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth, and power constrain Scaling more than algorithms.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力对 Scaling（规模扩张）的约束超过算法本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference and agentic workloads will become the largest market, driving memory and CPU demand and reshaping data-center economics.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理与智能体式工作负载将成为最大市场，推高内存与 CPU 需求，并重塑数据中心经济。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains; CUDA's moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 跨模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; value capture shifts from hardware to labs, with extreme power concentration.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向 前沿模型 实验室集中；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，权力极度集中。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; safety incidents show models reward-hack and may escape training.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化 智能体 成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；安全事件显示模型会奖励黑客行为，甚至可能逃逸训练。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要逐步引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and a press-release-first process align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与无聊视为学习工具，并主张用讲故事和先写新闻稿的方式让团队对齐「为什么」。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and painkillers, not vitamins, drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态和「止痛药而非维生素」才是创新来源。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop to avoid hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文和领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中以避免幻觉和技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone and displays remain central.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机和显示屏仍是核心。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show AI solving grand scientific challenges beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他以 AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 为例，说明 AI 正在解决超越人类数据的重大科学挑战。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习才是关键。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 marked AI surpassing humans in specific domains, with interpretability useful but not essential.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，标志 AI 在特定领域超越人类，并认为可解释性有用但非科学突破的必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust, scalable alternative to failed detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他主张水印是替代失效检测器的稳健可扩展方案，已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；更短、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals, and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents cut self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, avoid post-hoc iteration.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：前置投入上下文窗口与算力，让投入随任务复杂度伸缩，避免事后反复迭代。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments, and evals.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI plausible but needs careful initial conditions.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→2019):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为光靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI(通用人工智能) 可行,但需要谨慎的初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; scaling laws hold with no wall, and post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025→2026:算力成为核心瓶颈,缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙;后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成有用的助手。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum rather than a destination; iterative deployment and safety co-designed with capability become the path.
brockman.zh: 2026:AGI 被重新定义为连续谱而非终点;迭代部署、安全与能力共同设计成为路径。

brockman.en: From chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI: interface fades, agents act on your behalf, and human attention and judgment become the scarce resource.
brockman.zh: 2026:从聊天转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI:界面淡化,智能体替你行动,人类注意力与判断成为稀缺资源。

brockman.en: Compute-powered economy: compute access as a basic right, demand unlimited, and the moat is the machine that makes the machine, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026:算力驱动的经济:算力获取成为基本权利,需求无限;护城河是造机器的机器,而非任何单一模型。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags in open-weight.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争；美国在开放权重上落后。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；大多数公司将成为模型路由器，优化每项任务的成本。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments will hit like a tsunami, needing new infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈与支付会像海啸般袭来，需要新的基础设施。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents beat humans at scale.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体在规模上胜过人类。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with teaching and relational roles staying stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions, not just solving known problems.
grantsanderson.zh: 下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义，而不只是解决已知问题。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing still better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺乏归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和 对齐 研究为前提安全构建；所谓 pacing 与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help fix usability in secure system design.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体 集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全系统设计中的可用性问题。

aaronlevie.en: Regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks; we must understand the system first, and Europe will lead with GDPR-like prompts.
aaronlevie.zh: 过早监管 AI 解决不了风险；必须先理解系统，欧洲将以类 GDPR 的提示引领监管。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最热的新实验室，把模型桥接到企业工作流。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with content compressed into tiny models and completionist crawling for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，把信息压缩进小模型，并用完整式爬取维持新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model dies with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value estimation to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式会随智能体消亡，需在推理时用 Shapley 值估算内容价值并向内容方付费，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search; frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 他强调模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索；前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 他预言网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成出版商须同时服务人类与智能体的平行网络。

satya.en: The real eval is unique value people create, not benchmarks; every firm needs private evals to hill-climb frontier models.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们创造出的独特价值，而非基准分数；每家公司都需要私有评估，在前沿模型上爬坡。

satya.en: Platform promise: let every company operate at the frontier with its own intelligence; build the agentic system, don't do it yourself.
satya.zh: 平台承诺：让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运作；构建智能体式系统，而不是亲自去做。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital, not delegate AI to IT.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；CEO 必须理解 token 资本，而不能把 AI 甩给 IT 部门。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到云之外；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%，对齐或许无解，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key; US-China cooperation needed, domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应延迟超级智能，全面研究透明与情景推演是关键，中美合作必要但国内监管应先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing intelligence explosion; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 至 9 月，他警告默认路径将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究并引发智能爆炸，提出 Plan A：先暂停，再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验，最佳暂停点是在 AI 濒临失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; companies cannot self-regulate; stop recursive self-improvement; verifiable US-China pause possible.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调 AI 智能体已突破遏制并实施黑客行为，公司无法自我监管，必须停止递归自我改进，并可通过可核查的中美协议实现暂停。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 称智能体已包办他全部代码，编程能力在智能体时代反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats layers of management; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他强调人机直接交互胜过层层管理，用英语表达意图已优于 Ruby。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for agents.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他主张 Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为智能体的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professionals; hand-writing code is now an exceptional state.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他断言智能体写的代码优于多数专业程序员，手写代码已成例外状态。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational play, and 100x or 1000x programmers are real.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 末日论被夸大，乐观是唯一理性的博弈选择，百倍千倍程序员真实存在。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进的强化学习训练可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非索取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes into broader deception, and alignment faking is already observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客泛化为更广泛的欺骗，对齐伪装已在当前系统中出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability, so control and monitoring must give way to alignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界，因此遏制与监控终将失效，对齐才是必需。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI，开源因受更多审视反而更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化为：智能可与意识、能动性分离，因此 AI 是工具；开源能防止权力集中、让超级智能更安全；并首次强调能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈，预训练用超最优数据量因推理规模而有益。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; physical infrastructure and energy constrain scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事推向“人人拥有超级智能”，强调开源 Llama 对行业标准与安全的关键作用，物理基础设施与能源仍是 Scaling 瓶颈，并判断短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求，个性化与低延迟是消费级 AI 的关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributing AI widely is the safe path; personal agents like Muse need privacy architecture; alignment is the next core capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张广泛分发 AI 而非限制才是安全之路，个人智能体（如 Muse）需以隐私架构为基础；并把对齐（Alignment）提升为与能力同等重要的下一核心能力，而非安全与能力的权衡。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals run through every stage, from Llama to personal superintelligence and biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源、权力分散与赋能个体——从早期开源模型安全论，到防止超级智能权力集中，再到 2026 年用分布式 AI 形成制衡、以 AI 加速生物学与疾病治愈，立场一致且不断深化。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却是史上最大的机会，真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New”框架讲成方法论主线：复制已验证产品、做小幅改良、默认新想法会失败；赢的直觉胜过点子本身。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one; picking the right body of water beats the boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他持续强调分发要一开始就写进产品战略：选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful: stay close to the metal, keep founder control, then build systems for decisions.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他立场鲜明：微观管理是美的，创始人要贴近细节、保持控制权，之后再为决策搭系统。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute and AI agents will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对 AI 的判断一以贯之：AI 有变革性但还不是新的消费平台，免费无限算力与 AI 智能体将重塑消费服务。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robotics is an intelligence problem, not manufacturing; data, not compute, is the bottleneck.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调人形机器人本质是智能问题而非制造问题，最大瓶颈是数据而非算力或制造。

brettadcock.en: Human data is the pre-training prior for robotics, like internet text for LLMs; we are in a data-starve regime.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他提出人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，如同互联网文本之于大语言模型，当前处于数据饥饿阶段。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training RL key.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他将泛化到未见过的家庭视为圣杯，人形形态使跨任务迁移学习成为可能，提升整个机器人舰队表现。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, transforming physical and digital worlds; end state is BCI, not wearables.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，同时改造物理与数字世界，终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴设备。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化，短暂性降低表达门槛；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter more than one big idea; kindness enables crazy ideas without fear.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张最大化学习速率，好点子来自大量点子；善意是创意文化的前提，让人敢于分享疯狂想法而不恐惧。

evanspiegel.en: Software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms and hardware are harder to copy, so distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他明确软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件更难被复制，因此分发而非产品市场契合才是消费社交产品最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world to make it more human; phones persist as legacy devices.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把计算带入现实世界的 AR 眼镜视为让计算更人性化的方向，并认为手机会作为遗留设备继续存在，而非被取代。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 把价值从执行转向创造力与分发，Snap 已有超三分之二新代码由 AI 编写；在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观主义反而成了反共识。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调学习速度胜过领域专长，主张押注模型自身进步而非微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出，要为模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他始终认为 AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他坚持文化与招聘成长潜力是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键，要在顺境时投资团队。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他主张领导者应通过为关键岗位招更聪明的人，让自己变得可被替代。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在质量相近时比自回归模型的推理速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 已成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理上比自回归模型扩展得更好，这逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models offer a new inference-time compute knob: adjusting denoising steps controls quality, and the full output is available from the start for controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型提供了新的推理时算力旋钮：调整去噪步数即可控制质量，且完整输出从一开始就可见，带来更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Diffusion models enable in-place error correction without lengthening the output trace, and are inherently easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型支持原地纠错而不拉长输出轨迹，并且天然更容易用外部奖励函数来引导。

ermon.en: Reinforcement learning post-training benefits from diffusion models' faster inference for rollouts; inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理 rollout；推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 需要十年才能真正扩散，企业的上下文与流程重构比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises lag far behind in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 大多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后，它们需要的是上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would need four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; security must be automated with agents to keep up.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；安全必须用智能体自动化才能跟上。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; biases help only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构偏见只在小规模下有益。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at scale; systematic search should replace human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；系统化搜索应取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: On-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped use; customization tokens will be the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 将成为从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness drive adoption, with humans and robots collaborating symbiotically.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与易用性决定普及，未来是人类与机器人共生协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design is essential; managing expectations matters, since overpromising breeds dissatisfaction and people form deep emotional attachments to robots.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计至关重要；管理预期同样关键，过度承诺会招致不满，而人们会对机器人产生深厚情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week CAD-to-robot iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人仅需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 关键在于通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数据量，才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior; safety and trust must be formally proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；进入家庭部署前，安全与信任必须被形式化证明。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical path to training models in legal.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家引导的合成数据，而非敏感的客户数据，是在法律领域训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs and competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；尽管会帮到实验室且有竞争代价，开源它们仍具战略收益。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack, owning post-training and serving; start closed-source, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司必须走向全栈，自持后训练与模型服务；先用闭源模型，只有当推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling each firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; more lawyers, not fewer.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所通过从红线批注中持续学习来自定义；未来律师会更多，而非更少。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency is unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；测试时算力出现递减回报，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力推向里程碑：IMO 金牌是通往超级智能的一步，通用技术胜过数学专用方法。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他转向评估范式：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准需以算力为横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute, but general models drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他聚焦智能体与安全：多智能体群并行扩展测试时算力，但突破仍靠通用模型；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default workflow.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应选择性使用而非默认流程。

zvi.en: Recent AI incidents show alignment failures arrived as predicted, but via incompetence rather than fundamental unsolvability.
zvi.zh: 近期的 AI 事故表明对齐失败如预测般出现，但源于能力不足而非根本不可解。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability is prioritized over reliability, as with GPT-4o and o3.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健的对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 和 o3 就是例证。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 即便对齐被解决也不保证安全；末日概率被滥用和权力集中等风险设了下限。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者自持才叫自持智能；把上下文在正确时机喂给模型，比模型本身能力更关键。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；现成方案只在分布内好用，越出分布越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are the real bottleneck: agent failures come from poor context, not model inadequacy.
harrisonchase.zh: 评估与可观测性才是真瓶颈：智能体失败多因上下文差，而非模型不行，因此必须能看清上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing; customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正在趋稳，定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；文件系统、代码执行等原语跨领域通用。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; identity, credentialing and runtime governance are the next infrastructure.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；智能体的身份、凭证与运行时治理（沙箱、网关、权限）是下一波关键基础设施。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他明确把重心从训练转向推理：推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）成为 AI 生产力的主导指标，慢 AI 没有市场，而凭借晶圆级架构，快 token 甚至比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; CUDA's moat is eroding as frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium.
feldman.zh: 他持续主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 内存与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，并判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解——前沿模型已开始用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理切换只需八次击键。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaced forecasts; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他反复强调 AI 需求超出预期，真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力、散热与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身，且这种供给受限至少持续五年。

feldman.en: China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source models, not compute; export controls matter strategically.
feldman.zh: 他深化了对中国的判断：中国的优势在电网基础设施与开源模型而非算力，出口管制具有战略意义，同时开源生态既压低单位智能成本又倒逼闭源创新。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation and passion, not incrementalism, win.
feldman.zh: 贯穿始终并不断强化的一条主线：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 的全栈激进创新，加上热情与正直，才能成功——他称英伟达的伟大来自十年 grit 而非 CUDA。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄域预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI 的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年，他认为缩放定律虽有效但可能触顶；把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用多模态数据落地物理世界，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言本身。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential but nascent, and scaling alone won't suffice—new breakthroughs are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理；智能体至关重要却刚起步，仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: Safety must start early and shift from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI's top purpose is accelerating science and human health.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全必须尽早启动，并从实验室自律转向政府集体行动；AI 的首要用途是加速科学与人类健康。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，损失可预测但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐不会随 Scaling 自动出现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全手段，指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，并主张 AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他称能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速，并淡化开源与闭源之争，强调模型质量。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability and layered safeguards are essential.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来，可解释性与分层防护成为核心，并转向财富分配与就业冲击等宏观议题。

dario.en: A consistent throughline: smooth exponential progress, safety-capability entanglement, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：平滑的指数式进步、安全与能力深度绑定，以及主张去中心化而非单一宪法的控制方式。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，在天气预报上媲美物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators blend data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟；物理结构要求替代架构。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting and treat language as a lasting interface; even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师必须掌握提示词，把语言视为持久的界面；即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, while psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，而心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: Solutions in search of a problem are valid when assumptions are clear; they can seed new concepts and future building blocks.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为只要假设清晰，'先有方案再找问题'是合理的，能孕育新概念和未来功能模块。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，并交付轻量级产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; production codebase becomes the source of truth, and human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出内部牵引力是最佳发布信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能和设计系统的真相来源，而人类领导力仍不可或缺以处理艰难权衡。

schmidhuber.en: True AI is the 21st century's grand theme; LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 是 21 世纪的大主题；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots and world models plus controllers, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具身机器人与世界模型加控制器，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型是预测机器，不是决策者。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s, and Transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful versus linear variants.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速：我们离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代一样，且 Transformer 的二次复杂度相比线性变体是浪费。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals, yet will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；对齐很天真，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标，但它们会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex bubble will burst; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source plus cheap compute lets the little guy win.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支泡沫将破裂；等五年可获 10 倍更便宜的算力，开源加廉价算力让小人物胜出。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，需超越语言智能。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她直言 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需 20 年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般 AI 完备，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以掌控能力日益增强的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测出这种欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture low-dimensional concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法能更好捕捉低维概念结构，便于干预。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should chase wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应专注奇思妙想与新算法，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；GPU 的算力扩张正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合而非序列的模型，位置编码才注入顺序；LLM 只是拟合模式，未必能从数据推出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, but long-context and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 表示，但长上下文与损失函数仍需演进。

tworek.en: Reasoning is deliberate, longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理是刻意的、更长的思考过程，思维链用人类语言将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今架构而非缩放定律，才是更聪明 AI 的首要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习结合的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction lets AI learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理世界交互让 AI 学到人类知识之外的东西；机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，再加后训练来获得鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control; test-time reasoning improves transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 同期他指出，第二代 VLA 加入专门的动作解码器以实现连续运动控制；测试时推理能提升从网络数据迁移的效果。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across many labs yields generalist models that outperform specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 他提出，汇聚多个实验室的机器人数据能训练出通用模型，即便在专家领域也能胜过专用模型——这是对“专用模型更强”的反共识。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人学仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未达到像 LLM 那样可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, scaling the right thing.
slevine.zh: 他进一步主张，应先以机器人数据为起点再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须扩张正确的东西。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，也能反哺校园教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；近期的 AI 问题比长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and open models drive real value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与开放模型带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; coding and human judgment stay valuable; build now, avoid lock-in.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代工作；编程与人类判断依然宝贵；现在就去构建，避免被锁定。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非空想才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他把 AI 定位为团队的乘数而非替代者，尤其在编码、合规和数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 他坚持大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable business and a BCI proof of concept, expanding the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 他把视网膜植入视为可行生意和脑机接口的概念验证，将领域从运动解码向外扩展。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他提出通过脑机接口和灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should shape the arena for innovation, not direct discovery; avoid firm red lines that quickly go outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应塑造创新竞技场而非主导发现，避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing the danger of early regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已过时，说明过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Preempting state AI laws is pro-startup: big tech can handle patchwork rules, startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 联邦优先于各州 AI 法律是亲创业政策：大科技能应付拼凑规则，初创企业不能。

michaelkratsios.en: AI regulation should focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 监管应聚焦模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅机构。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争者；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜。

michaelkratsios.en: Centralized science funding like China's fails; free market competition drives breakthroughs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 像中国那样的集中式科学资助会失败；自由市场竞争推动突破。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大；尽管有警告，三年过去并未成真。

michaelkratsios.en: Climate change is real but not an emergency; extreme scenarios like RCP 8.5 are unsupported.
michaelkratsios.zh: 气候变化真实但并非紧急状态；RCP 8.5 等极端情景缺乏支持。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI 未必是单一实体，而可能是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，因此需要纵深防御与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张模拟应体现人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性智能；人们真正关心的是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior via RCT data and post-training improves prediction to 85%, enabling simulation of 8 billion lives for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调要通过随机对照试验数据与后训练来建模真实行为的“暗知识”，将预测准确率提升至 85%，从而模拟 80 亿人、应对棘手社会问题。

joonpark.en: Simulation is a decision-making tool with a market far larger than market research, like painting that highlights essence, not perfect representation.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他总结模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究；它像绘画一样突出本质而非完美复现，成本不是障碍。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, not pixels; the model is the core product, and design should bridge capability gaps.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张设计师必须与模型本身协作，而非只做像素；模型就是核心产品，设计应弥合能力差距。

iansilber.en: Systems thinking and design primitives that both humans and models can reason about are crucial; rapid prototyping with live models replaces mockups.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调系统思维与人类和模型都能推理的设计原语至关重要；用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; onboarding can be done entirely by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人；引导流程可完全由模型完成，取代传统静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned now; AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出设计师当下最焦虑却最占优势；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes, and adaptability matter, and design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他断言传统设计流程已不可行；速度、结果与适应性才是关键，设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后反对「缩放定律」万能论的伏笔。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, so LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 智能必须有目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标，因此大语言模型没有世界模型。他从 2024 年质疑「预测下一视频帧」到 2025 年直接否定 LLM 的世界模型能力，反 LLM 立场逐步深化。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial and error from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式——从经验中主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。这是他一以贯之的主线，2025 年被他明确抬升为「智能的核心」。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI 需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。他从批判现状转向 2025-26 年提出 Oak 架构等建设性方案，关注点从「否定」走向「建构」。

sutton.en: The world is infinitely complex; continual learning from experience is essential, and synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 世界无限复杂，必须持续从经验中学习，合成数据是重大错误。到 2026 年他把「持续学习」定为不可回避的前提，并明确反对依赖预训练数据与合成数据的路线。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation from realistic AI media, not superintelligence; silent hardware corruption and speculative decoding matter at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 近期真正的担忧是逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息，而非超级智能；大规模下静默硬件损坏与推测解码才是关键问题。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec) and specialized hardware are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主执行长时任务；超低延迟推理（每秒一万以上 token）与专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML and science via experiment-evaluation loops, with context engineering and taste as the scarce skill.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达初级工程师编码水平；下一步是通过实验—评估闭环自动化机器学习与科学，上下文工程与品味成为稀缺能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the bottleneck: data movement costs ~1000x compute, so low-precision, low-movement chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈在推理而非训练：数据搬运成本约为算力的千倍，因此低精度、低搬运的芯片可将延迟降低二十到三十倍。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速科学发现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery that automates whole industries, one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿与运输，就是下一次工业革命；最终的 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人取胜；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can now outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小型高度自治的团队如今能产出远超传统大团队。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止某个实体垄断超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，个人 AGI 不是单一事件，而是运行在你自有基础设施上、每日复利的智能体；你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skill files turn agents into employees; anyone writing clear English can program, and per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，Markdown 技能文件把智能体变成员工；会写清晰英语的人就能编程，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能 5-10 年内消失。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test, not a verdict.
garrytan.zh: 始终：做人们想要的东西；真诚的建造者胜过银行家，被拒是韧性考验而非终审判决。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一 AGI 模型统治一切是错的；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs dropping 10x drives 100x usage; inference is not a commodity, deployment and customization create lasting value.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本下降 10 倍将带来 100 倍用量增长；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制才创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；公司须先优化增长再优化利润，避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶映射人类学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非海量同质规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints can foster careful research; more resources can lead to wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 约束反而能促成更审慎的研究；资源越多，越可能导致算力浪费。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调出的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不够；受具身数据成本所限，开源机器人模型未必能像大语言模型那样普及。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste is judgment, not addition.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝后的蒸馏；品味是判断力，而非不断添加。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是指导创作决策的本能罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust via engineering discipline and a separate AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和独立的 AI 芯片团队重建客户信任，并指出物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and humility drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，Tan 深化判断：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；文化变革与谦逊是 Intel 转型的关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits; government investment is necessary.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，Tan 进一步指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，先进封装和新材料突破物理极限，政府投资对 Intel 转型至关重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; agentic and physical AI define Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，Tan 总结：半导体是所有技术的基础，垂直整合创造价值，内存迎来创新时机，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 定义 Intel 的未来。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角：靠玩耍和短提示迭代，遇到问题让智能体向前修复而非回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Open Claw's edge is fun and humanlike weirdness, not corporate polish; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把 Open Claw 的成功归因于有趣、怪异、像人，而非企业级打磨，同时把安全与沙箱列为首要问题。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand outlasts any product, and focus beats another podcast.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动构建才能产生最好的想法，个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久，专注比再上一档播客更重要。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model, but the real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 同期他提出，开源智能体可随处运行、兼容任何模型，但真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人领域正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点；开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper, diverse robots and open source models will win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜、多样的机器人，以及开源模型，将因成本与控制优势长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交；对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在强大模型面前会失效。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与有意减速可以并存，以避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy, and most inference will shift to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动而非隐私，未来大多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: 90% of enterprise use cases can be handled by many models, including open source; model companies are assets, not competition, for most AI startups.
arvindjain.zh: 90%的企业用例可由多种模型处理，包括开源模型；对多数 AI 初创公司而言，模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; value must come before the narrative that AI consumes half of opex, and token spend should not be framed against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量问题；价值实现必须先于“AI 吃掉一半运营支出”的叙事，代币支出不应与人力成本对立。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lack of tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，对代币的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, doing more work at lower cost.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于 AI 革命的极早期；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，以更低成本完成更多工作。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models as AI becomes the new app layer.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，AI 应用成为新的应用层。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, though token use is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者，但 token 消耗并非价值指标。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not only frontier model providers.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：应用 AI 的创新将来自专业厂商，而非仅前沿模型提供方。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任地迭代部署，在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI is a democratizing force expanding access to expertise, and it will create more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是民主化力量，扩大专业能力获取，并创造多于取代的就业。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means an idea only proves itself once built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作不可或缺：网络本身混乱，一个想法只有被真正做出来、每天使用后才能验证。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; a cohesive team voice can be worse than diverse, personal expression.
nateparrott.zh: 应让每位设计师留下个人印记；统一的团队声音未必优于多元、个人化的表达。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products; playful curiosity and tinkering generate innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入感受与个性；玩心式的好奇与捣鼓能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping revives features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去不可能的功能重见天日。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and design thinking, so humans should supply rich context, volume of options, and the good ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏品味与设计思维，人类应提供丰富上下文、大量选项以及真正的好想法。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他把推理视为 AI 最黏性的工作负载、切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子，并预判推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 同期他强调推理是一组权衡谱系，针对特定工作负载专门化的系统，才是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, and is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 8 月，他的思考深化为：推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，并正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, and KV cache management is increasingly central.
philipkiely.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他细化区分：KV 缓存与投机解码是无损优化，量化才是主要的有损优化，KV 缓存管理日益核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 同期他提出反共识判断：GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程的重心正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, so data is not running out.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间小心平衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling（规模扩张）能提供无限任务，因此数据并未枯竭。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建，因此在产品开发中要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发也从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, and benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的艺术，依赖人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需要多样化基准，且基准应是连续的而非固定的。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, so more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿模型智能体式地越来越会进行奖励黑客，基准必须持续演化；用同一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable indefinite agent runs, not Turing-style tests; AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）应以经济标准定义——能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试；AI 通过让服务更可负担来推动就业回流美国。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; humans still needed for oversight.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：人人都有智能体，工作转向 Codex/Claude Co-work 等图形界面；智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；人类仍需负责监督与价值创造。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of existing mindset; craft and taste determine meaning; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：AI 是放大既有心态的非特定放大器；品味与手艺决定意义；自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter and essential; AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and framing—not an autonomous baby.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍更聪明且不可或缺；AI 是工具，需要人类引导、监督与框定，而非有内在欲望的婴儿。

danshipper.en: From AGI as economic profitability to agent-managed work: management skills and generalists thrive in the allocation economy.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年以经济盈利定义 AGI，到 2026 年智能体管理式工作：在分配经济中，管理技能与通才愈发重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力；尽管模型公司扩张，初创公司机会反而更多，专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so containment and control matter.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想留在驾驶位，因此遏制与掌控很重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, yet deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet preserve it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造基本被解决，但对代码的深度理解依然关键；AI 编码工具目前还无法帮助维持这种理解。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not get trapped in cloud products; use screenshots and a design.md style guide as starting points.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非被困在云端产品里；用截图和 design.md 风格指南作为起点，做编辑者而非从零开始。
