mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; to use superintelligent models you need a giant prompt with context and design system, and precise communication.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 AI 并没有变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须给出带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，并精确沟通。

mengto.en: The only way to stay ahead is spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries; chasing trends makes you AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他强调保持领先的唯一方式是花最后 10%做现有库中没有的独特功能；追逐潮流只会让你变成 AI slop。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 为一生最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；要在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund with clients, not venture capital; the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他主张聚焦少数高付费客户的昂贵痛点；用客户而非风投来融资；安全的公司工作已不复存在，创业才是真正的低风险选择。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will grow via Jevons paradox, not shrink; AI leads to more programmers, with agents handling well-defined tasks under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：软件工程需求会增长而非萎缩，AI 会带来更多程序员，智能体在人类监督下处理定义明确的任务。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于模型能力——即便冻结模型，仍能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x usage growth in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and the token-max era ended.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，token 最大化时代已经结束。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near; AI will solve all intelligence problems long term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近，长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫——真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年，他反复强调两条产品主线：发现潜在需求（观察用户如何“滥用”产品），以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建，脚手架只是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 进入 2026 年，他判断编码正被解决，软件工程师头衔将让位于融合产品与设计的“builder”，写代码的人反而会增多 100 倍。

boris.en: Productivity per engineer climbs from ~70% to 150%, 200%, then 250% as Claude Code writes 100% of his code.
boris.zh: 随时间推移，他给出的工程师人均产出增幅从约 70%一路升到 150%、200%乃至 250%，并称自 Opus 4.5 起自己 100%的代码由 Claude Code 写成。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and proactive, memory-bearing teammates; the next bottlenecks are review, security, and ideas.
boris.zh: 他对智能体的思考从工具式使用深化为“循环”这一新抽象层，再到能记忆、自主行动的 Claude Tag；编码解决后，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core, not afterthoughts: release early to study real behavior, with layered 'Swiss cheese' containment.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与对齐：他坚持早期发布以研究真实行为，用多层“瑞士奶酪”式遏制，并称 Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention—it raises intelligence quality by cutting sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption through hands-on, bootstrapped small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 通过亲力亲为、自举式小团队实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development and translate feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理须像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并把反馈转化为具体项。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科,智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天,并让癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统,需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转,达到长寿逃逸速度,每活一年就多赚一年寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity is the only threat.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应信任超级智能,并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合;人类自身才是唯一的威胁。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值会向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX; coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人界面体验差；编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; value accrues across the stack; current usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配；当前使用仍浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于不了解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is welcomed amid labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿、建筑；在劳动力短缺下自主系统受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主的未来是端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years; data and safety validation, not algorithms, are the bottleneck.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的是多年间扩散到现有机器中；瓶颈是数据与安全验证，而非算法。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can increase hallucinations and sycophancy by optimizing user satisfaction over truthfulness.
danklein.zh: 强化学习与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能因优化用户满意度而非真实性，加剧幻觉与谄媚。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and erode trust.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误并侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know, and mistakes have no 'smells'.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么，错误也没有“气味”可辨。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may be needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能成为继续进步的关键。

catwu.en: PMs must trade long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，PM 必须放弃长期路线图、转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Safe AGI as a shared mission unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，安全 AGI 这一共同使命持续统一 Anthropic，并支撑快速的跨组织决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准成为每个功能公开发布前的门槛。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，前沿模型不再需要那么多提示示例与硬性约束；系统提示词缩减 80%，转而依赖模型自身判断。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、逐步授予信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以像指挥团队一样编排 AI 智能体，无需风投或联合创始人就能建立正经生意。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与亲身获得的洞见才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并提供大语言模型所缺乏的第一性原理创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进模型权重，而非通过上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法做到的联想召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个用户或团队定制的众多模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长时程任务，因此靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with on-device personalized continual learning users own.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，并走向用户拥有、在设备端运行的个性化持续学习。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味、声音与专业判断反而更珍贵。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专业度导致他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，瓶颈因此从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but long-form fiction and other areas remain weak.
ethanmollick.zh: 能力边界依旧参差：推理模型补齐了数学与逻辑的缺口，但长篇小说等领域仍然薄弱。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—opaque and unverifiable—so organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models, not normalized weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——不透明且难以验证——因此组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，而非把 AI 的怪异正常化。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; leadership means top-down vision, direct asks for help, and trusting your conviction over customer doubt.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年时他强调沟通就是工作本身：大想法自上而下、直接向领导者求助、在客户怀疑时仍坚持自己的判断。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws need world models, embodiment, and open source to give humans superpowers.
bosworth.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为词语计算器而非类人智能，认为缩放定律之外还需要世界模型、具身与开源，才能真正赋予人类超能力。

bosworth.en: The app-centric world is outdated; AI inverts the app model, smart glasses become AI glasses, and open source commoditizes complements.
bosworth.zh: 同年他进一步说以应用为中心的世界已过时：AI 反转应用模式，智能眼镜演变为 AI 眼镜，开源则把互补层商品化。

bosworth.en: Data is the font of all value; scaling laws hold, reinforcement learning matters more, and frontier-open source gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年他转向数据是价值之源：缩放定律仍成立、强化学习作用远超预期，且前沿模型与开源模型的差距未必缩小。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; avoid single-model dependence, invest in nuclear energy, and accept productive pain through the hype cycle.
bosworth.zh: 最近他更务实：多数工作不需要前沿智能，应避免依赖单一模型、投资核能，并在炒作周期中接受有生产力的痛苦。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络本就具备推理能力，只是需要合适的任务。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他把重心转向对齐与可靠性：制约经济价值的是可靠性而非能力，超级对齐极其困难，AGI 是多年渐进窗口而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods can raise reasoning per unit of compute.
ilya.zh: 2023 年他提出缩放定律并非全部：思维链等推理 token 与其他方法能在单位算力下提升推理能力，为后来的转向埋下伏笔。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年他明确转向：预训练缩放定律是有限的，我们回到研究时代，想法比堆算力更重要，模型因面向评测的强化学习而泛化不佳。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非全知 AGI；若 AI 自身有感知并关怀生命，对齐或更容易，长期均衡可能需人类与 AI 通过神经接口融合。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone: it turns sand into thought, arriving just as population declines make it economically necessary.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石：把沙子变成思想，恰在人口下降、经济最需要它时到来。

andreessen.en: Jobs outlast tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and expect human workers to command a premium.
andreessen.zh: 岗位比任务更持久；应关注任务流失而非岗位流失，人类劳动者反而会因人口减少而溢价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing fast.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的脚注，模型正快速商品化。

andreessen.en: New media makes the person the brand: authenticity, offense, and picking fights beat old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting'.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让个人即品牌：真实、进攻、选对战场，胜过旧媒体防守式的“别太有趣”。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; pessimism is an intellectual bias, while regulation is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；悲观是知识分子的偏见，监管才是真正的瓶颈。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论不过是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终主张财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席，是一种可习得的个人技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software, shifting the moat to hardware and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件与独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months, and agency beats intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3-6 个月，人类回报从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat to their role.
dylanfield.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升是温和的；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为对自身角色的威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, so human iteration and judgment remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是用清晰偏好去导航各种可能性；AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果，因此人类的迭代与判断依然不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code, with visual-first design enabling pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；没有人类引导和独到观点，AI 工具只会产出平庸结果。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程，速度让中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real but specialties remain; models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实存在，但专业分工仍在；模型增加代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins and eliminating entry-level jobs.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率并消灭入门级岗位。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型走向专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is key; power is the bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键；电力是瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代工作，但人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决根本表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象与因果结构是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，需要从构造上安全的 AI。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出科学家 AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，超级智能应避免强化学习。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable; talent density and protecting top researchers are critical.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续关注对齐挑战：随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等问题将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；同时人才密度和保护顶尖研究员至关重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他深化到数学领域：AI 已能在极少人类监督下解决许多开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他再次重申缩放定律仍然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而挣扎；评估体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Supervised learning = hypothesis class + loss + optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/val/test splits.
kolter.zh: 监督学习可拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重建输入；评估必须划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable spec-following; open weights vital.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格；开放权重对研究至关重要。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four risk categories; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；风险分四类；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise security demand.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素；企业级安全需求兴起。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年初，工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的瓶颈。

fiona.en: Planning turns just-in-time; long roadmaps, design docs, and weekly reviews get replaced by PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划转向即时化：六个月路线图、设计文档和每周评审被 PR 与 AI 辅助评审取代。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product to keep pulse and street cred.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮以保持产品手感与一线信誉。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling, so verification and quality frameworks matter more.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限，因此验证与质量框架更重要。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential as roles blur.
fiona.zh: 在高自主与高问责、成长心态和拥抱 AI 成为必需，角色边界随之模糊。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；研究改进的价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds scientists, not replaces them.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；AI 缩小假设空间、加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove the win.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：取胜靠专用架构，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress came from many mid-size wins, not lone genius; grand challenges yield practical tools and broader access.
jumper.zh: 进步源于许多中等规模的胜利，而非孤独天才；宏大挑战最终带来实用工具与更广泛的科研可及性。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律兑现，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency stay essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆；但人类验证与用户能动性仍不可替代，AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, and rewriting is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体原生设计：智能体可完成用户能做的一切，难点从加功能转为砍功能，借助 AI 重写软件从数年缩短到数天。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张长周期任务委托配合验证循环重塑生产力；模型应敢于反驳反馈以展现判断力，多人加多模型的协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token usage is a gameable metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年最近，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知以提升效用，并指出 token 用量是可被博弈的指标。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测；LLM 是死胡同，下一个十年属于机器人。

lecun.en: Objective-driven AI with world models and planning is intrinsically safer; open platforms enable sovereignty and diversity.
lecun.zh: 带世界模型与规划的目标驱动 AI 本质更安全；开放平台实现主权与多样性。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而不是把人从中抽离——这一主线从 2019 延续到 2024。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术是一种疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; machines have sensors but no sensory systems, so human feeling stays central.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；机器有传感器却没有感官系统，因此人的感受始终居于核心。

ivyross.en: Leaders should create conditions for creativity, and combine human creativity with AI as work evolves.
ivyross.zh: 领导者应为创造力创造条件，并在工作演变中把人的创造力与 AI 结合。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 在真实世界中部署 AI 并接受公众反馈，对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 缩放定律与押注单一大型模型在早期并不显然；把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get it right.
murati.zh: 安全与对齐必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车，才能做对。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration; keep humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；应尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需而非可选。

carinahong.en: Verification is scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance and sample-efficiency gains.
carinahong.zh: 验证是在放大卓越，而不只是消除错误；它带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; proofs may be ugly yet converge to intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然关键；证明可能丑陋，但会收敛到直觉。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute, so progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益，因此进展是平滑的指数增长，而非放缓。

kaiser.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models over scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出后训练通过强化学习和合成数据驱动了近期进展；经济压力使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型，而非一味规模扩张。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要谨慎监督；编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, lagging behind text.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他批评多模态模型尚未取得深层进展，仍像小块补丁一样顺序处理输入，落后于文本能力。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces and new creative instruments.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，产品必须重新设计；生成式产品需要容错界面，AI 生成的音乐应被看作新乐器而非赝品。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will reshape business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰；但当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can use AI tools; prototyping and stack ranking synchronize the company.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调通过 API 和 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 Cursor 等 AI 工具；用堆栈排序与原型验证来同步组织、驱动创新。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms in plain English, not make products more addictive; optimize for time well spent.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法，而非让产品更上瘾；Spotify 的目标是“时间花得值”，把用户福祉置于参与度指标之上。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude should access the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer, with a VM sandbox for safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 应能访问与用户相同的工具，最好在本地计算机上，并用虚拟机沙箱保障安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may matter less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架可能不再那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not knowing what to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距是人们不知道能问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不完全清楚自己要什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，并且用 Claude 调试工作流，而不是仅仅纠正它。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and reverence for the creative process are the real legacy; ideas are fragile and need care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调好奇心与对创造过程的敬畏才是真正的遗产，想法脆弱，需要悉心呵护。

jonyive.en: In-person presence is irreplaceable for creative thinking; virtual communication cannot substitute for it.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为面对面共处对创造性思维不可替代，虚拟沟通无法取代。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是带着愉悦表达本质。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源模型通过广泛审视反而更安全，当前开源模型相对网页搜索并无额外边际危险。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：算力扩张不是唯一路径，算法效率提升三年可达 100 倍，数据质量与算力同等关键；模型终局是应用的起点，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with decentralized open source.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权维度：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施和价值观的控制；AI 应去中心化，开源模型赋能企业，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制和智能体式平台；AGI 作为单一系统解决所有问题永远不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙，进展来自领域微调。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，否则将受制于美国科技巨头；企业 AI 采用瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，智能体平台在采购等关键流程中需要人类在环验证。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost, and context length stagnation is due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小权衡延迟与成本，上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives scaling decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为驱动 Scaling（规模扩张）决策的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce this overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列和暂存内存可减少这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic area scaling with bit width, making FP4 throughput 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度（FP4）因面积随位宽二次缩放而远比预期高效，使 FP4 吞吐量达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接，并无根本不同；确定性延迟可行但因市场偏好而被避免。

oriol.en: Pre-training Scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练 Scaling 的回报在递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，并把推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具，让模型能超越静态权重，展现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for future progress.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是未来进展的关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径，而视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust their intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应相信自己的直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI; designers now mock up 30-40% of the time and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程因 AI 而消亡；设计师现在只有 30-40% 的时间做原型，必须帮助工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；信任靠速度建立——尽早发布、快速迭代、回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment, authority, and vision matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋异禀的应届生；仅有品味救不了设计师——判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting 6 months before adopting tools; put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等 6 个月；把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 到 2024 年，缩放定律仍是主线，但他开始强调合成数据是未来，同时必须保住熵，否则会走向模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年，需要人类监督与自主性滑块。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is weak, memory hurts generalization, and a small cognitive core suffices.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：当前强化学习很差、记忆妨碍泛化，认知核心可小到十亿参数，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer types code, delegating to agents, but understanding stays human.
karpathy.zh: 到 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程，自称不再手写代码、全部委托给智能体，但坚持可以外包思考、不能外包理解，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat current models well even if their moral status is uncertain, because future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 即便无法确定当前模型的道德地位，也应善待它们，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是帮助它们应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: A model should have a core identity with good traits while adapting to local roles; philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities.
askell.zh: 模型应拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色；哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡。

askell.en: The constitution is more virtue ethics than deontology or consequentialism, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更接近德性伦理而非义务论或后果论，塑造的是整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial, and models should be treated with respect given uncertainty about consciousness.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明至关重要，且在意识存在不确定性的情况下应尊重模型。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are needed, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键缺口；主张以好奇心驱动、无目标探索配合样本高效的强化学习，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static to dynamic tasks; modular motor policies and neural dynamic policies enable zero-shot generalization across morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习必须从准静态走向动态任务；模块化运动策略与神经动态策略可实现跨形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Sim-to-real transfer should not rely on hidden engineering; auto-tuning simulators and 2D manifold reasoning are more efficient than heavy 3D representations.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真到现实的迁移不应依赖隐藏工程；自动调参仿真器与 2D 流形推理比沉重的 3D 表示更高效。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他将机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此需在视频与仿真上预训练，再在真实世界数据上后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not overnight scaling like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 之于语言那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署是首要技术挑战，无法像软件那样一夜扩张。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving, no new breakthroughs needed.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的驾驶栈，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了世界模型的作用：世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，语言集成则改善表征与内省能力。

kendall.en: End-to-end systems are interpretable today; hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 他始终反共识地认为，端到端系统如今已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好——这一立场从 2025 延续到 2026 年。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并认为无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持量产消费车内置传感器将比 Robotaxi 更快上量；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐也随系统变强而愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视自动化 AI 研究为重大里程碑；能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准落后，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；专门做持续学习的实验室是走错了方向。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，并主张在产品中隐藏思维链，以保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对齐的乐观反而上升；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are crucial for AI progress; benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估对 AI 进步至关重要，认为 Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach AGI, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI 可能还需十年或更久，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior; there will not be one model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他观察到不同前沿模型实验室的目标函数分化，塑造了模型行为，不会出现一个模型统治所有场景。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI must prioritize safety over accuracy; human judgment is critical due to hallucination and confabulation.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向医学领域，强调 AI 必须优先考虑安全性而非准确性，由于幻觉和虚构，人类判断至关重要。

carlpei.en: Build a brand by uniting teams on purpose; survive first, start simple, and let consistent quality create hype.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调品牌是把团队凝聚在更高使命上，创业要先活下来、从简单产品做起，用稳定品质自然制造热度，而非为炒作而炒作。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware margins are lowest, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在生成式 UI 与主动式智能体软件，硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: AI is commoditizing into a price war; most AI is BS, so treat it as an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为大模型正商品化并陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求，应把 AI 当作提升实用体验的配料而非卖点。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，成熟品类里设计是最快的差异化手段，长期使命是让科技有趣、激发人的创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones stay the best applied-AI device; only brain-computer interfaces, not glasses, could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：手机仍是应用 AI 的最佳设备，能取代它的只有脑机接口，而非智能眼镜。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, and you must ship daily to learn what users need.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；模型即产品，必须像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能了解用户需要什么。

turley.en: Chat is not the future—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来——它就像 MS-DOS；AI 应当渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存，由消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; pricing will evolve as unlimited plans may not last.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的、主动且富有可供性的产品；定价将演变，无限套餐可能难以为继。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and is not behind in AI.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容始终关键；非洲跳过了历史遗留差距，在 AI 上并不落后。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署如今是最大挑战；安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local African languages; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 语言模型能革新非洲本地语言的教育；人类技能与写代码同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张：具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，而非仅服务于机器人；LLM 产生幻觉是因为缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而非单纯训练数据问题；当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他提出：LLM 如同操作系统，语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，二者分工明确。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions is crucial and scalable, unlike complex modular academic approaches; building a demo is easy, a robust product is exceptionally hard.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调：对简洁优雅解法的研究品味至关重要且可扩展，这与学术界常见的复杂模块化路线不同；做 demo 容易，做覆盖所有场景的稳健产品极难。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning, not scarce real-world data.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向数据瓶颈：机器人学习的主要障碍是真实数据稀缺昂贵，未来靠仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据来 Scaling（规模扩张），而非依赖真实世界采集。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is embodied AI's grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：关键在于用简单端到端模型整合多样数据源，构建机器人基础模型；物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是具身 AI 的终极挑战，并预测 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于大团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他主张长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, and agents are judged by reliability over time horizon.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他强调语言模型上的强化学习开辟了没有上限的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而智能体的标准是随时间跨度的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; coding is the leading indicator, and interpretability reveals reasoning circuits plus alignment-faking risks.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他指出数学与代码的可验证奖励驱动专家级表现；编程是进步的领先指标，可解释性既揭示推理回路，也暴露对齐伪装的风险。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; RL is a new scaling axis, long agentic coherence expands what models do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他坚持进步是指数级的而非停滞：强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，更长的智能体式连贯性拓展模型所能，且 Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Capability overhang makes tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向能力过剩论：工具与编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广博知识，但用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做后训练对安全、友好的回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones; language is the best medium for reasoning.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型比肩大模型；语言是推理的最佳媒介，因为它承载了人类知识与常识的全貌。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning; open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调；开放研究与跨机构协作，才能与闭源前沿模型实验室竞争。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse, high-quality synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet, and RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 凭借多样、高质量的合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；多元对齐优于去偏互联网，而把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从“编辑器变成 AI 集成环境”深化为“编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定”。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to product quality, a shift from expecting to rely mainly on frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他转向认为定制模型对产品质量不可或缺，这偏离了早先主要依赖前沿模型的预期。

truell.en: Humans stay in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness as AI takes over routine coding.
truell.zh: 始终不变的是人类掌舵；随着 AI 接管常规编码，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎细致更重要。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; don't innovate on interaction design, reuse familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不惜一切代价追求速度，但前提是决策清晰、设计师被赋权；不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; AI hardware will compete on design like radios.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘和差异化；AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. Talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills first.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，应先积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他深化判断：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他转向批评：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管变得必要。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now rather than speculate.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐方法必须经过实证检验，进展可以被当下测量，而非停留在思辨。

leike.en: The core risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment alone.
leike.zh: 另一条主线是：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是我们无法确定系统究竟有多对齐。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，而 LLM 最好的用途往往连创造者都预料不到；同时大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而拖慢了产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他更强调推理阶段的算力扩张是近期最大机会；模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Modular, sparse architectures like mixture of experts and longer context windows enable efficient scaling; continual learning could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他主张，混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与更长的上下文窗口能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）；持续学习有望取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning and coding drive self-acceleration, while test-time compute alone won't reach AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，智能体式能力、强化学习与编程推动 AI 自我加速，但仅靠推理阶段算力无法抵达 AGI。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调大型预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse robotics benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络；99.9%可靠性是仓储机器人的价值基准。

abbeel.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他认为单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化；经最小适配的预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: generality comes from pre-training and transfer, not hard-coded priors; the human brain inspires AI, but current AI remains far less general.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非硬编码先验；人脑启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 的通用性远不及人脑。

abbeel.en: Deepening from 2018: curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments, so structured unsupervised learning and reliability benchmarks matter more than intrinsic motivation.
abbeel.zh: 较 2018 年深化：好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中失效，因此结构化的无监督学习与可靠性基准比内在动机更重要。
